assets.caption: Table 1 Task, Authorities and Responsibilities of Project Members during HFE implementation

cells.value: Project Manager (or delegate i.e. Project Engineer)

Heads Project Ergonomics Team (PET).

Approves the scope of Human Factors engineering input for the project.

Decides on the participants of PET.

Decides on scope changes with respect to HFE.

Assurance of HFE programme.

Approves execution of PIR.

Ensures that PET members have appropriate competence to carry out activities (including HFE).

Participates in PET.

Participates/carries out situation task analysis.

Identifies operational and/or maintenance requirements.

Informs plant management on progress and dilemmas

Mediates between operation/maintenance organization and project organization on HFE matters.

Addresses HFE in project meetings.
